projects.name: BuildResumeNow
projects.description: A full-stack AI-powered resume builder that leverages generative AI to help users craft professional resumes in minutes. Built as an independent product with end-to-end ownership from ideation through deployment and user acquisition. The platform combines template-driven design with smart AI suggestions to personalize content for different roles and industries.
projects.outcomes: Successfully shipped to market with organic user acquisition and sustained user engagement. Demonstrates full product lifecycle ownership: user research → feature prioritization → deployment → iteration based on user feedback. Generated sustainable revenue through SaaS model with recurring user base.

projects.name: Careless / Project Sukoon - On-Device Health Nudge App
projects.description: A voice-first daily health nudge application designed for budget Android phones in the Indian market. Combines on-device machine learning (Gemma 3 2B) with Flutter frontend and RAG-powered personalization. Core innovation: real-time difficulty adaptation via three-button friction signals (too hard / done / too easy) without requiring cloud round-trips. Architected to overcome on-device ML latency constraints through pre-embedded datasets (sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2) hosted on Cloudflare R2, eliminating embedding computation on low-end hardware.
projects.outcomes: Engineered under strict constraints (APK <40MB, sub-100ms latency for nudges on budget phones). Designed with 7-day build timeline targeting APK release to first 10 users. Demonstrates ML optimization for resource-constrained devices, real-time adaptation algorithms, and Hindi/Indian language health domain expertise. Key architectural innovation: pre-computed embeddings strategy eliminates 500ms+ on-device embedding latency, enabling voice-first UX on Snapdragon 400-series processors.

projects.name: Infraon - AIOps (Intelligent Events Platform)
projects.description: AIOps is an enterprise-grade intelligent event management platform designed to reduce network noise and automate root cause analysis across complex infrastructures. As a Senior Backend Developer and Team Lead, I architected and lead development for predictive alerting, automated RCA (Root Cause Analysis), and advanced observability. Core work includes: (1) Time-series forecasting (Facebook Prophet, XGBoost) for anomaly detection, (2) Hybrid RAG-powered root cause analysis combining historical incident embeddings with semantic search to match current events to similar past incidents, enabling LLM-driven causal inference, (3) Stream processing pipelines ingesting millions of telemetry events daily from Kafka/RabbitMQ, (4) Vector database integration (pgvector/Qdrant) for semantic similarity queries across incident histories. Currently expanding RCA with multi-modal RAG: embedding incident narratives, metrics, and topology data to deliver contextual root cause hypotheses in sub-second latency.
projects.outcomes: Delivered intelligent event noise reduction and automated RCA tools adopted by major Indian enterprises, resulting in 35% improvement in incident response times and 60% reduction in mean-time-to-resolve (MTTR). RAG-powered RCA currently in beta, showing 4-5x faster root cause identification vs. traditional alerting.
